name: mm-exam-studio
description: A monorepo template built with Bun, Hono, Vite, and React
author: Steve Simkins

scripts.cf:deploy:client: cd client && bun run build && bunx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name examstudio --commit-dirty=true
scripts.cf:deploy:admin: cd admin && bun run build && bunx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name adminstudio --commit-dirty=true
scripts.cf:deploy:api: cd server && bun run cf:deploy:pdf && bun run cf:deploy
scripts.cf:deploy:frontends: bun run cf:deploy:client && bun run cf:deploy:admin
scripts.cf:deploy: bun run cf:deploy:api && bun run cf:deploy:frontends
